objective_pt: Contar uma notícia que você leu ou ouviu ("I read that...", "Apparently..."), usar a voz passiva simples ("was arrested", "were injured") e reagir a notícias com "Really? That's awful!".

teacher.goal_pt: Aquecer falando de como a pessoa acompanha as notícias.
prompts: How do you usually get your news?
Did you hear any interesting news this week?
watchFor: Usar "a news" ou "the news are"; "news" é incontável e singular: "the news is".
Dizer "I saw in the internet"; é "I saw it online" ou "on the internet".

exercises.prompt: Did you hear about what happened downtown?
accepted: Did you hear about what happened downtown
Have you heard about what happened downtown

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e diga que você lê as notícias no celular.
exercises.listen: How do you usually keep up with the news?
accepted: I read the news on my phone
I usually read the news on my phone
I read it on my phone
On my phone
I usually read news on my phone
I check the news on my phone
Mostly on my phone

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Ler algo no celular é "on my phone", com "on".
commonErrors.correction_en: I read the news on my phone.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "News" é incontável e singular: "I read it", e não "I read them".
commonErrors.correction_en: I read the news on my phone.

exercises.explanation_pt: "News" termina em "s" mas é incontável e singular: "The news is terrible". Uma notícia é "a piece of news".

teacher.goal_pt: Aprender palavras de notícias e a voz passiva mais comum.
prompts: Do you trust news on social media?
watchFor: Confundir "journal" (diário, revista científica) com jornal; jornal é "newspaper".

exercises.example_en: The headline says prices are going up again.
Apparently, the concert was canceled because of the rain.
Two people were injured in the accident.
Always check the source before you share anything. It could be fake news.

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Eu li no jornal que vai ter uma greve."
accepted: I read in the newspaper that there's going to be a strike
I read in the newspaper that there will be a strike
I read in the paper that there's going to be a strike
I read in the newspaper that there is going to be a strike
I read in the news that there's going to be a strike
I saw in the newspaper that there's going to be a strike

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Jornal é "newspaper" (ou "paper"). "Journal" é diário pessoal ou revista acadêmica.
commonErrors.correction_en: I read in the newspaper that there's going to be a strike.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Vai ter" (existir) é "there's going to be" ou "there will be", e não "will have".
commonErrors.correction_en: I read in the newspaper that there's going to be a strike.

teacher.goal_pt: Pronunciar "news" (com "z" no fim) e os particípios terminados em "-ed" da voz passiva.
prompts: Say "news". Is it "news" with S or with Z?
watchFor: Pronunciar "news" com "s" sibilante; o som final é "z": "nyuz" ou "nuz".
Colocar vogal extra em "canceled" ("cancelédi"); são só duas sílabas: "CAN-seld".

exercises.prompt: Have you seen the news today?
accepted: Have you seen the news today
Did you see the news today

exercises.instruction_pt: Repita. "Arrested" tem o "-ed" como sílaba; "canceled" e "closed" não.
exercises.prompt: The man was arrested, the game was canceled, and the road was closed.
accepted: The man was arrested, the game was canceled, and the road was closed
The man was arrested, the game was cancelled, and the road was closed

exercises.instruction_pt: Em qual palavra o "-ed" é uma sílaba a mais?
exercises.explanation_pt: Depois de "t" ou "d" o "-ed" vira sílaba: arrest-ed. Em "closed" e "canceled" ele é só um "d".

teacher.goal_pt: Entender uma notícia curta e reagir de forma natural.
prompts: Did you hear? The airport was closed this morning.
watchFor: Reagir só com "Ok"; ensine "Really? What happened?", "That's awful!", "No way!".
Esquecer o "was/were" na passiva: "two people injured".

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça a notícia e escolha o que aconteceu.
exercises.listen: Heavy rain caused flooding in the south of the city last night. Several roads were closed, but nobody was hurt.
options: Ninguém se feriu, mas algumas ruas foram fechadas.
Várias pessoas se feriram na enchente.
A chuva foi fraca e nada aconteceu.
exercises.explanation_pt: "Several roads were closed" = várias ruas foram fechadas; "nobody was hurt" = ninguém se feriu.

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça a notícia e reaja com surpresa, perguntando o que aconteceu.
exercises.listen: Did you hear? They closed the airport this morning.
accepted: Really? What happened
No way! What happened
Seriously? What happened
What? What happened
Really? Why
Oh no! What happened
Really? Why did they close it
Wow, what happened

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "O que aconteceu?" é "What happened?". Sem "did": quando "what" é o sujeito, o verbo vai direto no passado.

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e conte a notícia: dois carros bateram e uma pessoa ficou ferida.
exercises.listen: So what happened on the highway?
accepted: Two cars crashed and one person was injured
Two cars crashed and one person was hurt
There was an accident. Two cars crashed and one person was injured
Two cars hit each other and one person was injured
Two cars collided and one person was injured
Apparently two cars crashed and one person got hurt

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Na voz passiva falta o "was": "one person was injured". Sem ele, parece que a pessoa feriu alguém.
commonErrors.correction_en: Two cars crashed and one person was injured.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Bater" (o carro) é "crash". "Beat" é bater em alguém ou vencer.
commonErrors.correction_en: Two cars crashed and one person was injured.

teacher.goal_pt: Contar uma notícia: o que, onde, quando, e reagir à notícia do outro.
prompts: Tell me about something that happened in your city recently.
What's the biggest news story this year?
watchFor: Esquecer o passado: "Yesterday the police arrest a man".
Não dizer a fonte; ensine "I read that..." e "According to...".

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Segundo o jornal, o show foi cancelado."
accepted: According to the newspaper, the concert was canceled
According to the newspaper, the show was canceled
According to the paper, the concert was canceled
According to the newspaper, the concert was cancelled
According to the news, the concert was canceled
The newspaper says the concert was canceled

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Segundo" (de acordo com) é "according to". "Second" é o número ordinal.
commonErrors.correction_en: According to the newspaper, the concert was canceled.
According to the newspaper, the concert was canceled.

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Pelo visto, o prefeito foi preso."
accepted: Apparently, the mayor was arrested
Apparently, the mayor has been arrested
Apparently, the mayor got arrested
It seems the mayor was arrested
It looks like the mayor was arrested

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Prefeito é "mayor". "Prefect" é outra coisa (um cargo escolar ou administrativo em alguns países).
"Pelo visto" é "apparently" ou "it seems". "By the view" é tradução literal.

exercises.instruction_pt: Coloque as palavras na ordem certa.
accepted: The new bridge was opened last week.

exercises.instruction_pt: Conte uma notícia recente que chamou a sua atenção.
exercises.prompt_en: Tell me about a news story that caught your attention recently. What happened, and what do you think about it?
guidelines_pt: Diga onde você viu: "I read online that..." ou "I saw on the news that...".
Conte o que aconteceu no passado, usando pelo menos uma frase na passiva ("was closed", "were injured").
Dê a sua opinião: "I think it's..." ou "It's crazy that...".

teacher.goal_pt: Fixar "news" no singular, "according to" e a passiva com "was/were".
prompts: What was canceled or closed recently in your city?

exercises.prompt: That's great news! I'm so glad to hear that.
accepted: That's great news! I'm so glad to hear that
That is great news. I am so glad to hear that

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Tenho uma boa notícia!"
accepted: I have some good news
I've got some good news
I have good news
I've got good news
I have a piece of good news
Guess what? I have good news

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "News" é incontável: "some good news" ou só "good news", nunca "a good news".

exercises.instruction_pt: Qual frase está na voz passiva?
exercises.explanation_pt: Passiva = "be" + particípio: "was arrested". "The man arrested" sozinho diria que ele prendeu alguém.

exercises.sentence: Three people ___ injured in the fire.
accepted: were

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Three people" é plural e a notícia está no passado: "were injured".
commonErrors.correction_en: Three people were injured in the fire.
